hook_styles.name: Bold Provocative Claim
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open immediately with a counter-intuitive assertion that challenges conventional supercar wisdom within the first 7 seconds.

hook_styles.name: High-Stakes Secret Crisis
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open with a dramatic, confidential crisis or secret crash during development that almost killed the project.

hook_styles.name: Sensory Telemetry Shock
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open directly with visceral acoustic and physics telemetry: the exact G-force, exhaust frequency, or turbo boost pressures.

hook_styles.name: Underdog Historical Paradox
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open with an unexpected historical clash or bitter feud that forced engineers to attempt the seemingly impossible.

hook_styles.name: Statistical Anomaly
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open with a mind-boggling number or cost comparison that sounds mathematically impossible but is 100% true.

hook_styles.name: Insider Confidential Reveal
hook_styles.prompt_instruction: Open with what factory test drivers and confidential factory service bulletins revealed that was never mentioned in the marketing brochure.
